name: Depth Perception
definition: The ability to judge which of several objects is closer or farther away from you, or to judge the distance between you and an object.

benchmark.name: KITTI Depth Prediction Benchmark
benchmark.metric: SILog (scale-invariant logarithmic error ×100, on the official KITTI test server; lower is better)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who rely on depth perception at work (e.g., drivers, equipment operators), judging distances to objects in outdoor road scenes

benchmark.name: NYU Depth V2
benchmark.model_or_system: DPT-Hybrid (Dense Prediction Transformer, fine-tuned on NYUv2)
benchmark.metric: δ1 threshold accuracy (% of pixels with max(pred/gt, gt/pred) < 1.25), NYU Depth V2 Eigen test split
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal vision (the O*NET Depth Perception ability applies broadly, e.g. drivers, equipment operators, tradespeople) judging distances and near/far ordering in indoor scenes.

benchmark.name: NYU Depth V2
benchmark.metric: δ1 threshold accuracy (% of pixels with max(pred/gt, gt/pred) < 1.25), percentage
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce (people who judge distances as part of ordinary work, e.g., drivers, warehouse and trades workers). The comparison is scaled to the benchmark's condition: estimating metric distance from a single static indoor photograph.

benchmark.name: NYU Depth V2
benchmark.metric: RMSE in meters (lower is better) on the NYU Depth V2 Eigen test split
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce, the typical person who judges near/far and distance in everyday work. The comparison is to their ability to judge relative order and metric distance from a single-viewpoint indoor image.

benchmark.name: KITTI Depth Prediction
benchmark.metric: SILog, scale-invariant logarithmic error [log(m)*100]; lower is better
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population, especially drivers and workers who judge distances to objects in outdoor or traffic scenes. The O*NET Depth Perception ability is broadly held and not a specialist skill.

benchmark.name: DA-2K
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population, since ordinal depth judgment from images is a universal perceptual ability and not a specialist skill.

benchmark.name: DA-2K
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population, since ordinal depth judgment from images is a universal perceptual ability and not a specialist skill.
